---
name: adversarial-confirmation
description: Review consequential architecture, public API, product-surface or semantic decisions using independent premise and evidence checks. Use for disputed boundaries or feature survival, not routine implementation changes.
---

# Adversarial confirmation

Apply [the scoped review protocol](references/protocol.md). Quote the relevant
frozen premises verbatim; distinguish implementation evidence, derivation and
owner product decisions. Choose independent reviewer questions and give each
the minimum sufficient evidence without the preferred answer.

Use [the packet template](assets/packet-templates.md) only when useful. Preserve
narrow conclusions and reopening conditions; stop review rounds when there is no
new concrete finding, then return to authorized implementation.
